SLAY_SPOON_SYNC.title: Slay the Spoon
SLAY_SPOON_SYNC.body:
With mods active, Slay the Spire 2 uses a separate profile that starts with nothing unlocked.

Copy your regular progress into it on every launch? Your regular save is only read, never changed. Progress made only in modded runs is replaced at the next launch.

To change your answer later, delete mod_configs/SlaySpoon.cfg in the game's user folder.
